Method of Attack: Blank root password allowing login without password
Regression of security patch allowing blank sp_pwdp field in /etc/shadow
Removal of 'disable root by default' flag causing bug regression
Impacted Systems: Official Docker images based on Alpine Linux distribution
Attack Vector: Exploiting blank root password vulnerability in Alpine Linux Docker images
Use of Linux PAM or other mechanisms using system shadow file for authentication
Indicators of Compromise: Vulnerable builds from v3.3 to 3.9 of Alpine Linux Docker image
